name: BBQ Chicken Meatballs with Bell Peppers & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

Meanwhile, place chicken, bread crumbs, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and salt in a medium bowl; using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the chicken mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g ground chicken
½ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the meatballs are cooking, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 yellow bell pepper
1 orange bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell peppers, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until peppers are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Return meatballs to the skillet, add sauce, and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce and meatballs are warmed through, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice, meatballs, and peppers between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
